items: Fast, responsive guest communication gets harder with every location you add, so customer support software becomes essential once you run multiple stores or a franchise.
Look for one workspace that brings conversations from email, chat, social media, messaging apps, phone and review sites together, so no guest message slips through the cracks.
Use AI and automation for routing and routine questions, so your team spends its time on the complex cases that need a person.
For restaurants, Momos' AI agent Alfie replies to every review within minutes in your brand voice and can issue points, coupons and offers through your loyalty platform.
